meaning: Pinned source requirements, not certification or evaluated compliance

classification.automated_reference: Every direct source control has a mapped native check; this does not prove full requirement coverage or equivalent predicates
classification.manual_or_mixed: At least one source control is reviewed as manual; other controls may be automated
classification.rejected_reference: All direct source controls were rejected as invalid or obsolete; reasons are retained
classification.missing_unmapped: Source requirement has no direct source controls in the pinned tree
classification.missing_or_partial: At least one direct source control lacks an accepted native or manual mapping

hacktricks_best_practices.reason: No independently enumerated control identifiers exist in the native catalog's thematic HackTricks tags; they cannot be scored as a complete framework.
